metadata.short_desc: Let the LLM privately message configured UIDs when it wants to complain.
metadata.desc: Registers an LLM tool that sends complaint messages to the UID list configured in WebUI, optionally attaching the most recent chat messages as evidence (OneBot platforms only). Includes auto-ban: users who trigger too many complaints within a time window are blocked from interacting with the bot.

receiver_uids.hint: UIDs that should receive private complaint messages. Messages are sent on the same platform as FriendMessage sessions.

message_template.hint: Available variables: {accused}, {reason}, {content}, {sender_id}, {sender_name}, {session_id}, {evidence} (recent chat log; appended at the end when the variable is absent)

forward_recent_messages.hint: ⚠️ OneBot (aiocqhttp) only — other platforms cannot fetch chat history and are skipped silently. When on, the most recent messages at complaint time are forwarded to the receivers.

recent_message_count.hint: ⚠️ OneBot (aiocqhttp) only. Defaults to 5, capped at 100; larger values are clamped and 0 disables it. Messages longer than 300 characters are truncated.

ban_window_hours.hint: Sliding window used to count violations; decimals allowed. Auto-ban is disabled unless x, y and z are all positive.

ban_max_violations.description: Max violations y within the window
ban_max_violations.hint: A sender who triggers this many complaints inside the window is banned automatically. Set 0 to disable auto-ban.

ban_duration_hours.hint: How long a banned user is blocked from interacting with the bot; decimals allowed.

ban_message_template.hint: Message shown when a banned user tries to interact with the bot. Available variable: {banned_time} (remaining ban hours).
